changes.reason: Node listen static serving runs the configured middleware that declares the security-headers capability around static file and SPA fallback responses, so the headers it sets reach HTML documents and assets. Other global middleware, missing-path fall-through and operational routes are unchanged; the middleware chain and header merge used by controller routes moved to module functions and are reused unchanged. No option, export or host lifecycle changes.

kubernetes.reason: Static files are served only by the Node listen path, which registers the staticDir route; a real local socket test requests a static asset, the HTML document and an SPA fallback path with securityHeadersMiddleware configured.
constraints: Local Node host-runtime evidence only; no live Kubernetes deployment or provider certification.

evidence.testName: NodeAdapter real server smoke sends configured security headers with static files and the SPA shell over a real Node socket

aws-lambda.reason: The Lambda adapter dispatches through the fetch handler without calling listen, so the staticDir route is never registered there; controller routes keep the same middleware chain.

cloudflare.reason: staticDir serving reads the local filesystem through node:fs behind the Node TCP listener; Worker isolates use their separate fetch transport.
constraints: No Node static file serving is claimed for Workers; no Node Container profile is introduced.
